description: One declared Force Majeure event (IDEV-3129). SUBMITTING a Trigger declares the event live for the dates it covers; CANCELLING it ends the event for every customer at once. Pricing is only overridden while a submitted Trigger covers the transaction date AND "Enable Force Majeure" is on in Fuelbuddy Settings AND an Approved Force Majeure Pricing for the customer covers the date. One event at a time: a Trigger cannot be saved if its window overlaps another draft or submitted Trigger (a blank end counts as open-ended); cancelled Triggers never clash.

fields.description: First transaction date this event covers (inclusive).
fields.label: FM Period Start

fields.description: Last transaction date this event covers (inclusive). Leave blank for an open-ended event that runs until this Trigger is cancelled.
fields.label: FM Period End
